zh.sourceText: 某洗发水品牌在黄金时段反复投放广告：『连续五年销量全国第一！』广告想让你相信，销量第一就代表它是最好的洗发水，所以你应该选择它。品牌还请来当红明星代言，明星在片尾说：『我也只用它。』【gap:gap1】然而，一家第三方零售监测机构去年的报告显示，在连锁药店渠道的去屑品类里，销量第一的其实是另一款平价品牌。某测评博主随后发声：『我用过一百种洗发水，这款确实最好。』

textRefs.reason_1: 销量第一就代表它是最好的洗发水
textRefs.gap1_correct: 广告没有交代『连续五年销量全国第一』的统计口径——覆盖哪些渠道、统计周期多长，而第三方报告显示换一个渠道，结果就完全不同
textRefs.distractor_1: 我用过一百种洗发水，这款确实最好

gap1: 广告没有交代『连续五年销量全国第一』的统计口径——覆盖哪些渠道、统计周期多长，而第三方报告显示换一个渠道，结果就完全不同
该品牌请明星代言花费高达数千万元，说明品牌实力雄厚、值得信赖
去屑洗发水的整体市场规模近三年一直在萎缩

hints: 先找结论与理由：『销量第一 = 最好』，这个跳跃你接受吗？
留意正文里哪些是广告方的『证据』，哪些是第三方信息
最后一步找空洞：『全国第一』到底是怎么统计出来的？
zh.explanation: 结论是「你应该选择它」，理由是『销量第一就代表最好』。广告用明星代言、博主证言制造可信氛围，但真正该追问的是：『连续五年全国第一』按什么口径统计？第三方监测报告显示，在药店去屑品类里销量第一的是另一款平价品牌——说明『第一』取决于你怎么数渠道。没有统计口径的数字等于没有数字；代言和『我用过一百种』都只是个人背书。

en.sourceText: A shampoo brand keeps running a prime-time ad: 'Best-selling in the country for five straight years!' The ad wants you to believe that being the best-seller means it is the best shampoo, so you should choose it. The brand also hired a popular star, who says at the end of the commercial: 'I only use it too.'【gap:gap1】Yet a report last year by an independent retail-monitoring agency showed that in the anti-dandruff category sold through chain pharmacies, the best-seller was actually another budget brand. A reviewer influencer then chimed in: 'I've tried a hundred shampoos — this one really is the best.'

textRefs.reason_1: being the best-seller means it is the best shampoo
textRefs.gap1_correct: The ad never explains how 'best-selling in the country for five straight years' was measured — which channels were counted and over what period — and the third-party report shows a different channel gives a completely different winner
textRefs.distractor_1: this one really is the best

gap1: The ad never explains how 'best-selling in the country for five straight years' was measured — which channels were counted and over what period — and the third-party report shows a different channel gives a completely different winner
The brand spent tens of millions hiring the star, which shows the brand is strong and trustworthy
The overall anti-dandruff market has been shrinking for the past three years

hints: Find the conclusion and the reason: 'best-seller = best' — do you accept that leap?
Notice which parts of the text are the advertiser's 'evidence' and which are third-party information
Finally, find the gap: how exactly was 'best in the country' measured?
en.explanation: The conclusion is 'you should choose it', supported by 'being the best-seller means being the best'. The ad builds trust with a celebrity endorsement and a blogger's testimony, but what you should really ask is: on what methodology does 'best-seller for five straight years' rest? The third-party report shows that in pharmacy anti-dandruff sales, a different budget brand ranks first — 'number one' depends entirely on which channels you count. A number without methodology is not a number; endorsements and 'I've tried a hundred' are just personal backing.
